stories.headline: TSMC Forecasts $1.5T Chip Market by 2030, Says AI Wafer Demand to Rise 11x by 2026

key_facts.fact: TSMC told its 2026 Technology Symposium on May 14 that AI accelerator wafer demand is projected to grow 11-fold between 2022 and 2026, and raised its global semiconductor market forecast to exceed $1.5 trillion by 2030, up from a previous $1 trillion estimate.
key_facts.excerpt: TSMC held its Taiwan Technology Symposium today. According to Reuters, the company said that demand for AI accelerator wafers is projected to grow 11-fold between 2022 and 2026. TSMC also raised its forecast for the global semiconductor market, now expecting it to exceed US$1.5 trillion by 2030, up from its previous US$1 trillion estimate.

key_facts.fact: Capacity for TSMC's 2nm and next-generation A16 nodes is projected to grow at a 70% CAGR from 2026 to 2028, while CoWoS advanced-packaging capacity is forecast to grow at more than 80% CAGR from 2022 to 2027.
key_facts.excerpt: TSMC said capacity for its most advanced 2nm and next-generation A16 chips is projected to grow at a 70% CAGR from 2026 to 2028, while CoWoS (Chip on Wafer on Substrate) advanced packaging capacity is forecast to achieve a CAGR of more than 80% from 2022 to 2027.

key_facts.fact: TSMC plans to build nine phases of wafer fabs and advanced packaging facilities in 2026, and currently mass-produces a 5.5-reticle CoWoS at 98% yield, with plans for a 14-reticle, 20-HBM-stack version in 2028 and a 24-HBM-stack version in 2029.
key_facts.excerpt: The company also plans to build nine phases of wafer fabs and advanced packaging facilities in 2026... TSMC's currently mass-produced 5.5-reticle-size version is the world's largest today and has already achieved yields of 98%. The report adds that TSMC plans to rapidly scale CoWoS, targeting a 14-reticle-size version capable of integrating 20 HBM stacks in 2028, before moving beyond 14 reticles with support for up to 24 HBM stacks in 2029.

key_facts.fact: TSMC said its Arizona output is expected to increase 1.8-fold year over year by 2026, with the first fab in production, tool move-in for fab 2 in 2H26, fab 3 under construction, and work on fab 4 and the site's first advanced-packaging facility set to begin this year.
key_facts.excerpt: Arizona: The first fab is already in production. Tool move-in for the second fab is planned for the second half of 2026. Construction of a third fab is underway. Work on a fourth fab and the site's first advanced packaging facility is expected to begin this year. TSMC anticipates a 1.8-fold year-on-year increase in Arizona output by 2026, with yields comparable to those in Taiwan.

key_facts.fact: AI and high-performance computing are expected to account for 55% of the $1.5 trillion market, followed by smartphones at 20% and automotive at 10%.
key_facts.excerpt: AI and high-performance computing are expected to account for 55 per cent of the $1.5 trillion market, followed by smartphones with 20 per cent, and automotive applications with 10 per cent, according to TSMC.

stories.headline: Kioxia Forecasts Record $8.2B Q1 Operating Profit, Announces Plans to List in the US

key_facts.fact: Kioxia on May 15 said it expects operating profit for the April–June quarter to reach ¥1.3 trillion ($8.2 billion), beating analyst estimates, as AI demand drives memory chip prices.
key_facts.excerpt: Japanese memory chipmaker Kioxia said on Friday it expected operating profit for the April-June quarter to reach 1.3 trillion yen ($8.20 billion) as the artificial intelligence boom boosts chip demand.

key_facts.fact: Kioxia reported full-year operating profit of ¥870.4 billion for the year ended March, up 92.7% year-over-year and beating estimates, and posted record quarterly earnings of ¥596.8 billion for the March quarter.
key_facts.excerpt: The maker of NAND flash memory chips reported operating profit rose 92.7 per cent to 870.4 billion yen in the year ended March, beating estimates.

key_facts.fact: The company said it is preparing to list American depositary shares on a U.S. exchange to grow its investor base, following its Tokyo listing in late 2024 after being carved out of Toshiba by a Bain Capital-led consortium.
key_facts.excerpt: Kioxia said it is preparing to list American depositary shares on a U.S. exchange to grow its investor base. Kioxia has seen years of upheaval including a carve-out from scandal-hit Toshiba by a Bain Capital-led consortium and a listing in Tokyo in late 2024.

key_facts.fact: Kioxia is the world's best-performing major stock this year, with shares up roughly 300% year-to-date, riding a global NAND flash shortage driven by AI server demand.
key_facts.excerpt: Kioxia Holdings Corp., the world's best performing major stock this year, said it would list its shares in the US as it reaps the benefits of a global memory chip shortage that's ratcheted up prices of the vital component to historic highs.

key_facts.fact: Fiscal-year revenue rose 37% to ¥2.34 trillion, and profit attributable to owners of the parent reached ¥554.5 billion, more than doubling year-over-year, on AI-server and enterprise SSD demand.
key_facts.excerpt: The company reported revenue of ¥2.34 trillion in fiscal year 2026, up 37% from the previous year, and profit attributable to owners of the parent reached ¥554.5 billion, more than double the year's previous year.

stories.headline: Iceotope Raises $26M Series B for Precision Liquid Cooling as AI Racks Push Past 1MW

key_facts.fact: Sheffield-based Iceotope announced on May 14 a $26 million Series B funding round to advance its precision liquid cooling technology for AI and high-performance data centers.
key_facts.excerpt: Iceotope Group, the leading provider of precision liquid cooling technology solutions, announced the close of a $26M series B funding round.

key_facts.fact: The round was co-led by Two Seas Capital and Barclays Climate Ventures, with participation from existing investors Edinv, ABC Impact, Northern Gritstone and British Business Bank.
key_facts.excerpt: The investment was led by Two Seas Capital and Barclays Climate Ventures along with participation by existing investors Edinv, ABC Impact, Northern Gritstone and British Business Bank.

key_facts.fact: Iceotope said next-generation GPU and accelerator platforms are driving rack power densities toward 1 megawatt and beyond, rendering air cooling and direct-to-chip liquid cooling insufficient.
key_facts.excerpt: AI infrastructure is approaching a thermal inflection point. Next-generation GPU and accelerator platforms are driving rack power densities toward 1MW and beyond, rendering air cooling and direct-to-chip liquid cooling insufficient.

key_facts.fact: Iceotope's chassis-based approach replaces air with dielectric fluid circulated directly around server components inside a sealed chassis; flagship products include KUL BOX and KUL AI for high-density AI rack deployments.
key_facts.excerpt: The company's approach, which is called chassis-based precision liquid cooling, replaces air with dielectric fluid circulated directly around server components inside a sealed chassis. The current product line includes KUL BOX and KUL AI, designed for high-density rack deployments at the heart of new AI data centres.

stories.headline: Figure AI Humanoids Sort 28,000 Packages in 24-Hour Fully Autonomous Run

key_facts.fact: Figure AI on May 14 completed a 24-hour autonomous test of three humanoid robots — Bob, Frank and Gary — that ran without human control and sorted more than 28,000 packages.
key_facts.excerpt: California-based robotics startup, Figure AI, has completed a 24-hour test of its humanoid robots that have been operating 24 hours without failure, extending the operation into a multi-day operation. The company's three humanoid robots, named Bob, Frank, and Gary, are operating without human control and have already sorted over 28,000 packages.

key_facts.fact: The robots detect barcodes, place packages on conveyor belts using onboard cameras and AI reasoning, and run on Helix-02, a system combining vision, touch sensing, proprioception and whole-body control.
key_facts.excerpt: The robots detect barcodes, place packages on conveyor belts using onboard cameras and AI reasoning, and use Helix-02, a system designed to combine vision, touch sensing, proprioception, and whole-body control.

key_facts.fact: When a robot gets stuck or hits an unfamiliar situation, the Helix-02 system can trigger an autonomous reset and resume work with zero human intervention; the run was livestreamed online.
key_facts.excerpt: The operation was livestreamed online, with viewers tracking the robots' uptime and performance... If a robot gets stuck or encounters an unfamiliar situation, the AI system can trigger an autonomous reset and resume work without human intervention.

key_facts.fact: The benchmark builds on Figure's earlier work at BMW's Spartanburg, South Carolina plant, where Figure 02 robots have contributed to the movement of more than 90,000 parts.
key_facts.excerpt: Figure's broader commercial deployments — including earlier work at BMW's Spartanburg, South Carolina facility, where Figure 02 robots contributed to the movement of more than 90,000 parts — will provide the ground truth that lab demonstrations cannot.

stories.headline: Intel Begins Testing Production of Low-End Apple iPhone, iPad and Mac Chips on 18A-P

key_facts.fact: Analyst Ming-Chi Kuo reported on May 14 that Apple has kicked off low-end/legacy iPhone, iPad and Mac processor production at Intel on the 18A-P series using Foveros packaging.
key_facts.excerpt: Apple has kicked off low-end/legacy iPhone, iPad, and Mac processors at Intel on the 18A-P series (using Foveros packaging).

key_facts.fact: Kuo said the order mix is roughly 80% iPhone, mirroring Apple's end-device sales mix, and that Apple views Intel as 'one of the very few, and arguably the most complete' foundry training alternatives to TSMC.
key_facts.excerpt: The order mix is roughly 80% iPhone, mirroring Apple's end-device sales mix... 'For the next several years, the bulk of advanced-node orders will remain with TSMC. Apple is therefore one of the very few, and arguably the most complete, foundry training opportunities available to' Intel.

key_facts.fact: Apple believes TSMC's resources will continue tilting toward AI customers, motivating the dual-source strategy with Intel's Arizona fabs.
key_facts.excerpt: Apple reportedly weighs Intel's 18A-P for 2027 entry-level Mac chips, challenging TSMC's exclusive grip... Apple's potential Intel partnership hinges on 18A-P process maturity by 2027.

key_facts.fact: Intel's 18A-P is the company's first node to support Foveros Direct 3D hybrid bonding, using a pitch of less than 5 microns to stack multiple chiplets through TSVs.
key_facts.excerpt: The 18A-P process is a derivative announced by Intel at the Direct Connect 2025, the company's first node to support Foveros Direct 3D hybrid bonding. The hybrid bonding approach will allow Intel to stack multiple chiplets through TSVs, and it is claimed that the Foveros Direct 3D bonding technology will use a pitch of less than 5 microns.

stories.headline: Korea's WIRobotics Raises $68M Series B to Accelerate Humanoid Commercialization

key_facts.fact: WIRobotics on May 14 announced a KRW 95 billion (~$68 million) Series B funding round to accelerate humanoid commercialization and expand into integrated robotics platforms.
key_facts.excerpt: Global robotics company, WIRobotics, has secured a KRW 95 billion (USD 68 million) Series B funding round to accelerate its humanoid commercialization and expand into integrated robotics platforms.

key_facts.fact: The round was led by J. Investment, with participation from InterVest, Hana Ventures, Smilegate Investment, SBVA, NH Investment & Securities, Company K Partners, GU Investment and FuturePlay.
key_facts.excerpt: The investment was led by J. Investment, with InterVest, Hana Ventures, Smilegate Investment, SBVA, NH Investment & Securities, Company K Partners, GU Investment, and FuturePlay.

key_facts.fact: Cumulative sales of WIRobotics' ALLEX humanoid platform have surpassed 3,000 units across Europe, China, Türkiye and Japan, and the company plans to launch a research-focused humanoid platform later this year.
key_facts.excerpt: The firm's humanoid robotics platform, ALLEX, has surpassed 3,000 cumulative units sold and expanded into key overseas markets including Europe, China, Türkiye, and Japan. Wirobotics plans to launch a research-focused humanoid platform later this year.

key_facts.fact: The company has been selected for the second cohort of the Physical AI Fellowship powered by AWS, Nvidia and MassRobotics.
key_facts.excerpt: WIRobotics today announced it has been selected for the second cohort of the Physical AI Fellowship, a virtual program powered by Amazon Web Services, NVIDIA, and MassRobotics.

stories.headline: AtkinsRéalis Q1 Profit Jumps 34% as Nuclear Bet Targets AI Data Center Power Demand

key_facts.fact: AtkinsRéalis reported a 34% year-over-year jump in Q1 profits on May 14, driven by its nuclear business as the engineering company banks on the technology to seize on AI data center power demand.
key_facts.excerpt: AtkinsRéalis Group Inc.'s nuclear business powered a 34 per cent year-over-year jump in profits last quarter, as the engineering company banks on the technology to seize on soaring demand for energy-hungry AI data centres.

key_facts.fact: On Wednesday May 13, AtkinsRéalis signed a 20-year agreement with First American Nuclear to design and oversee construction of small modular reactor projects in North America.
key_facts.excerpt: On Wednesday, the firm signed a 20-year agreement with power company First American Nuclear for Atkins to design and oversee construction of its U.S. partner's small modular reactor projects in North America.

key_facts.fact: Preliminary work is underway at Ontario's Pickering nuclear plant after AtkinsRéalis and Aecon signed a $2.1-billion contract to extend the life of four reactors, and the company secured a 2025 deal to extend a Cernavoda reactor and earlier won a contract to build two new multibillion-dollar reactors in Romania.
key_facts.excerpt: Preliminary work is now underway at Ontario's Pickering nuclear power station after AtkinsRéalis and Aecon Group Inc. signed a $2.1-billion contract for a life extension on four reactors last year. Money is also rolling in from Romania, where the company secured a deal in 2025 to extend the life of a reactor at the Cernavoda nuclear plant — after winning a contract the year before to build two new multibillion-dollar reactors there.

key_facts.fact: In March, AtkinsRéalis announced a partnership with Nvidia to ramp up deployment of nuclear-powered AI factories, exploring how to integrate Nvidia's technologies into the facilities.
key_facts.excerpt: In March, it announced it was teaming up with Nvidia to ramp up deployment of nuclear-powered artificial intelligence factories, as the two parties explore how to work the chipmaking giant's technologies into developing the facilities.

key_facts.fact: A CANDU full-size reactor built by Candu Energy, an AtkinsRéalis subsidiary, takes about seven years to plan and build, and 'nuclear remains the primary growth engine,' per National Bank analyst Maxim Sytchev.
key_facts.excerpt: A CANDU full-size reactor built by Candu Energy — an AtkinsRéalis subsidiary that draws on nuclear technology licensed exclusively by the company from the federal government — takes about seven years to plan... 'Nuclear remains the primary growth engine,' said National Bank analyst Maxim Sytchev in a note to investors.

sources.title: AtkinsRéalis bets on nuclear-powered AI factories amid data centre surge
